title: Unifying Partner and Environment Diversity to Improve Human-AI Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2611.32031v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Real-world applications of modern AI systems require generalization to both unseen environments and novel human users. The field of zero-shot coordination (ZSC) has focused primarily on deploying AI to cooperate with novel partners in otherwise familiar environments. Popular population-based methods achieve this by partnering the agent with a diversity of simulated human users during training in a fixed environment, but does not consider the more realistic scenario where both the users and the environment are unseen during training. Recently, training across environments has been explored in training a single self-play agent, which shows better generalization on both novel human users and unseen environments. In this work, we ask whether jointly modeling partner diversity and environment diversity yields stronger coordination with novel partners in novel environments. We introduce Cross Environment Co-Play (CECP), a two-stage framework

translated_title: 统一伙伴多样性与环境多样性以提升人机协调能力
translated_abstract: 现代人工智能系统的现实应用需要其能够泛化到未见过的环境以及陌生的人类用户。零样本协调（ZSC）领域主要关注在熟悉的环境中部署AI以与陌生伙伴进行合作。流行的基于种群的方法通过在固定环境的训练过程中让智能体与多样化的模拟人类用户配对来实现这一目标，但没有考虑更为现实的场景，即用户和环境在训练期间都是未见的。最近，有研究探索了在跨环境训练中训练单个自博弈智能体，该方法在陌生人类用户和未见环境上均表现出更好的泛化能力。在本工作中，我们探究联合建模伙伴多样性与环境多样性是否能够在陌生环境中与陌生伙伴实现更强的协调。我们提出了跨环境协同博弈，这是一个两阶段框架
tldr: 该论文提出跨环境协同博弈（CECP）两阶段框架，通过统一建模伙伴多样性与环境多样性，显著提升AI智能体在陌生环境中与陌生人类伙伴的协调泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Cross Environment Co-Play (CECP), a two-stage framework that unifies partner and environment diversity to improve AI agents' coordination with novel human partners in unseen environments.
